# Certificate renewal automation — FigDown source

I only had the genre‑independent core doc verbatim (not `reference/scene.md` / `reference/layout.md`), so I kept the block syntax to the conservative, self‑evident forms the core doc itself demonstrates: `block <id> "<label>"` declarations and `<id> -> <id> "<label>"` edges, no layout pins, no classes (nothing here needs a stated meaning beyond the labels). This is normative `block` territory, so it should render on any `0.1` engine — run it through `build-svg.js` and fix anything it flags before embedding.

```figdown
# FigDown — figures as text. Spec: https://github.com/FigDown/figdown
figdown 0.1 block
title "Certificate renewal automation"

block scheduler "Scheduler"
block renewaljob "Renewal job"
block caclient "CA client"
block ca "Certificate authority"
block deployagent "Deploy agent"
block service "Service"

scheduler -> renewaljob "timer trigger"
renewaljob -> caclient "obtain certificate"
caclient -> ca "request certificate"
renewaljob -> deployagent "hand off certificate"
deployagent -> service "restart"
```

Once built, embed it with the standard footer:

```markdown
![Certificate renewal automation: scheduler triggers a renewal job, which asks a CA client to obtain a certificate from the CA, then hands off to a deploy agent that restarts the service](figures/cert-renewal.svg)

<sub>source: [figures/cert-renewal.fd](figures/cert-renewal.fd)</sub>
```
